d.title: Inazuma Eleven Go vs. Danball Senki W Movie
d.jp: 劇場版 イナズマイレブンGO vs ダンボール戦機W
syn: Gekijouban Inazuma Eleven Go vs Danball Senki W
d.synopsis: As Shinsei Inazuma Japan was about to have a match with Inazuma Legend Japan, a mysterious attack of a person and a swarm of robots interrupted, and another mysterious girl's power drove the world into another dimension. As the world of Inazuma Eleven Go and Danball Senki W met, the two teams must work together to find out what happened to their worlds.
